description: This file defines the DynamoAIGuardrails class which integrates DynamoAI's moderation and policy enforcement capabilities into the LiteLLM framework. It includes methods for calling the DynamoAI API, processing responses, and integrating guardrail checks into various stages of LLM interactions, such as pre-call, moderation, post-call, and streaming.

classes.name: DynamoAIGuardrails
classes.description: A class providing integration of DynamoAI's moderation and guardrail capabilities within the LiteLLM framework, including methods for API calls, response processing, and guardrail enforcement across different stages of LLM interaction.

methods.name: DynamoAIResponse _call_dynamoai_guardrails( self, messages: List[Dict[str, Any]], text_type: str = "input", request_data: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Makes an asynchronous API call to DynamoAI to analyze messages for policy violations.

methods.name: DynamoAIProcessedResult _process_dynamoai_guardrails_response( self, response: DynamoAIResponse )
methods.description: Processes DynamoAI API response to extract violations and their details.

methods.name: GuardrailStatus _determine_guardrail_status( self, response_json: DynamoAIResponse )
methods.description: Determines guardrail status (success, intervened, failed) based on DynamoAI response.

methods.name: str _create_error_message(self, processed_result: DynamoAIProcessedResult)
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message summarizing detected violations.

methods.name: Union[Exception,str,dict,None] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Pre-call hook to analyze messages before sending to LLM, potentially blocking the call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Moderation hook running during the call, can reject or flag content before LLM processing.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-call hook to analyze and enforce policies on the generated LLM response.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[ModelResponseStream,None] async_post_call_streaming_iterator_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: Any, request_data: dict, )
methods.description: Passes streaming response items for guardrail analysis, useful for PII masking or similar streaming guardrails.

methods.name: Optional[Type[GuardrailConfigModel]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for guardrail settings.
